user=Depends(current_user)):\n375\t    57\t    counts = {ctype.key: ctype.module.count_by_status() for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES}\n376\t    58\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n377\t    59\t        request, \"admin/home.html\",\n378\t    60\t        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n379\t    61\t         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n380\t    62\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n381\t    63\t    )\n382\t    64\t\n383\t    65\t\n384\t    66\t@router.get(\"/content\")\n385\t    67\tdef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n386\t    68\t                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n387\t    69\t                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n388\t    70\t    \"\"\"Data Bites and Reports together, most recently updated first,\n389\t    71\t    optionally narrowed to one type and/or one status.\"\"\"\n390\t    72\t    items = [(ctype, item) for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES if content_type in (\"\", ctype.key)\n391\t    73\t             for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)]\n392\t    74\t    items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[1][\"updated_at\"], reverse=True)\n393\t    75\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n394\t    76\t        request, \"admin/content.html\",\n395\t    77\t        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n396\t    78\t         \"items\": items, \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES,\n397\t    79\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n398\t    80\t         \"chosen\": {\"type\": content_type, \"status\": status}},\n399\t    81\t    )\n400\t    82\t\n401\t    83\t\n402\t    84\t@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n403\t    85\tdef preview(body: str = Form(\"\")):\n404\t    86\t    \"\"\"The sanitized HTML for a Markdown body, for the edit forms' live\n405\t    87\t    preview. Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n406\t    88\t    return HTMLResponse(render_markdown(body))\n407\t=== app/templating.py\n408\t     1\t\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\n409\t     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n410\t     3\t\n411\t     4\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n412\t     5\tfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n413\t     6\t\n414\t     7\tfrom app import settings\n415\t     8\tfrom app.auth import csrf_token\n416\t     9\tfrom app.flash import confirmation\n417\t    10\tfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n418\t    11\tfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n419\t    12\t\n420\t    13\t\n421\t    14\t\n422\t    15\t@pass_context\n423\t    16\tdef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n424\t    17\t    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n425\t    18\t    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n426\t    19\t    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n427\t    20\t    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n428\t    21\t    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n429\t    22\t\n430\t    23\t\n431\t    24\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n432\t    25\ttemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\n433\t    26\ttemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\n434\t    27\ttemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\n435\t    28\ttemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\n436\t    29\ttemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n437\t=== app/auth.py\n438\t     1\t\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n439\t     2\t\n440\t     3\tThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\n441\t     4\titsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\n442\t     5\tre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\n443\t     6\taccount ends its sessions at once.\n444\t     7\t\"\"\"\n445\t     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n446\t     9\t\n447\t    10\timport secrets\n448\t    11\timport sqlite3\n449\t    12\t\n450\t    13\tfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n451\t    14\t\n452\t    15\tfrom app import users\n453\t    16\t\n454\t    17\t\n455\t    18\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n456\t    19\t    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n457\t    20\t\n458\t    21\t\n459\t    22\tdef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n460\t    23\t    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n461\t    24\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n462\t    25\t    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n463\t    26\t    if user is None:\n464\t    27\t        request.session.clear()\n465\t    28\t        raise LoginRequired\n466\t    29\t    return user\n467\t    30\t\n468\t    31\t\n469\t    32\tdef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n470\t    33\t    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n471\t    34\t    if not users.is_director(user):\n472\t    35\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n473\t    36\t    return user\n474\t    37\t\n475\t    38\t\n476\t    39\tdef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n477\t    40\t    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n478\t    41\t    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n479\t    42\t    request.session.clear()\n480\t    43\t    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n481\t    44\t    csrf_token(request)\n482\t    45\t\n483\t    46\t\n484\t    47\tdef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n485\t    48\t    request.session.clear()\n486\t    49\t\n487\t    50\t\n488\t    51\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n489\t    52\t    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n490\t    53\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n491\t    54\t    if token is None:\n492\t    55\t        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n493\t    56\t    return token\n494\t    57\t\n495\t    58\t\n496\t    59\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n497\t    60\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n498\t    61\t    match the session's.\"\"\"\n499\t    62\t    form = await request.form()\n500\t    63\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n501\t    64\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n502\t    65\t    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n503\t    66\t            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n504\t    67\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n505\t=== app/reports.py\n506\t     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n507\t     2\t\n508\t     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n509\t     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n510\t     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n511\t     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n512\t     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n513\t     8\t\n514\t     9\tA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\n515\t    10\treplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\n516\t    11\tstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n517\t    12\t`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n518\t    13\t\n519\t    14\tA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\n520\t    15\tfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\n521\t    16\tremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\n522\t    17\tits file and its images.\n523\t    18\t\n524\t    19\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n525\t    20\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n526\t    21\t\"\"\"\n527\t    22\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n528\t    23\t\n529\t    24\timport sqlite3\n530\t    25\tfrom pathlib import Path\n531\t    26\t\n532\t    27\tfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\n533\t    28\tfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\n534\t    29\tfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\n535\t    30\tfrom app.users import is_director\n536\t    31\t\n537\t    32\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n538\t    33\t_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\n539\t    34\tLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n540\t    35\t\n541\t    36\tget = _TABLE.get\n542\t    37\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n543\t    38\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n544\t    39\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n545\t    40\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n546\t    41\t\n547\t    42\t\n548\t    43\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n549\t    44\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n550\t    45\t\n551\t    46\t\n552\t    47\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n553\t    48\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n554\t    49\t    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n555\t    50\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n556\t    51\t\n557\t    52\t\n558\t    53\tdef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n559\t    54\t    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n560\t    55\t    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n561\t    56\t\n562\t    57\t\n563\t    58\tdef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n564\t    59\t    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n565\t    60\t    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n566\t    61\t    if pdf is None:\n567\t    62\t        return None\n568\t    63\t\n569\t    64\t    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n570\t    65\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n571\t    66\t        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n572\t    67\t\n573\t    68\t    return attach\n574\t    69\t\n575\t    70\t\n576\t    71\tdef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n577\t    72\t    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n578\t    73\t    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n579\t    74\t    if get(report_id) is None:\n580\t    75\t        return False\n581\t    76\t    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n582\t    77\t\n583\t    78\t\n584\t    79\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n585\t    80\t           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n586\t    81\t    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n587\t    82\t    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n588\t    83\t    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n589\t    84\t    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n590\t    85\t\n591\t    86\t    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n592\t    87\t        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n593\t    88\t        if attach:\n594\t    89\t            attach(conn, report_id)\n595\t    90\t\n596\t    91\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n597\t    92\t\n598\t    93\t\n599\t    94\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n600\t    95\t           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n601\t    96\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n602\t    97\t    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n603\t    98\t    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n604\t    99\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n605\t   100\t                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n606\t   101\t        return True\n607\t   102\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n608\t   103\t\n609\t   104\t\n610\t   105\tdef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n611\t   106\t    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n612\t   107\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n613\t   108\t        removed = conn.execute(\n614\t   109\t            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n615\t   110\t            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n616\t   111\t            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n617\t   112\t        ).rowcount == 1\n618\t   113\t    if not removed:\n619\t   114\t        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n620\t   115\t    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n621\t   116\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n622\t   117\t    return True\n623\t   118\t\n624\t   119\t\n625\t   120\tdef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n626\t   121\t    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n627\t   122\t    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n628\t   123\t\n629\t   124\t\n630\t   125\tdef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n631\t   126\t    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n632\t   127\t    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n633\t   128\t    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n634\t   129\t    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n635\t   130\t                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n636\t   131\t        return True\n637\t   132\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n638\t   133\t\n639\t   134\t\n640\t   135\tdef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n641\t   136\t    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n642\t   137\t    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n643\t   138\t    if name not in images(report_id):\n644\t   139\t        return False\n645\t   140\t    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n646\t   141\t                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n647\t   142\t        return True\n648\t   143\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n649\t   144\t\n650\t   145\t\n651\t   146\tdef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n652\t   147\t    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n653\t   148\t    Report.\"\"\"\n654\t   149\t    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n655\t   150\t        return False\n656\t   151\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n657\t   152\t    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n658\t   153\t    return True\n659\t   154\t\n660\t   155\t\n661\t   156\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n662\t   157\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n663\t   158\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n664\t=== app/data_bites.py\n665\t     1\t\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n666\t     2\t\n667\t     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\n668\t     4\tand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\n669\t     5\ta Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\n670\t     6\tauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n671\t     7\t\n672\t     8\tPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n673\t     9\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n674\t    10\t\"\"\"\n675\t    11\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n676\t    12\t\n677\t    13\timport sqlite3\n678\t    14\tfrom pathlib import Path\n679\t    15\t\n680\t    16\tfrom app import chart_images\n681\t    17\tfrom app.content import ContentTable\n682\t    18\t\n683\t    19\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n684\t    20\t_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n685\t    21\t\n686\t    22\tget = _TABLE.get\n687\t    23\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n688\t    24\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n689\t    25\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n690\t    26\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n691\t    27\t\n692\t    28\t\n693\t    29\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n694\t    30\t    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n695\t    31\t    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n696\t    32\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n697\t    33\t                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n698\t    34\t\n699\t    35\t\n700\t    36\tdef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n701\t    37\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n702\t    38\t    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n703\t    39\t\n704\t    40\t\n705\t    41\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n706\t    42\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n707\t    43\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n708\t    44\t\n709\t    45\t\n710\t    46\tdef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n711\t    47\t    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n712\t    48\t    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n713\t    49\t        return False\n714\t    50\t    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n715\t    51\t    return True\n716\t    52\t\n717\t    53\t\n718\t    54\tdef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n719\t    55\t    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n720\t    56\t    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n721\t    57\t\n722\t    58\t\n723\t    59\tdef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n724\t    60\t    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n725\t    61\t    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n726\t    62\t    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n727\t    63\t        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n728\t    64\t\n729\t    65\t\n730\t    66\tdef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n731\t    67\t    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n732\t    68\t    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n733\t    69\t        return False\n734\t    70\t    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n735\t=== app/main.py\n736\t     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n737\t     2\t\n738\t     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\n739\t     4\tat /. 55\t@router.get(\"\")\n    56\tdef admin_home(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    57\t    counts = {ctype.key: ctype.module.count_by_status() for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES}\n    58\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    59\t        request, \"admin/home.html\",\n    60\t        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n    61\t         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n    62\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    63\t    )\n    64\t\n    65\t\n    66\t@router.get(\"/content\")\n    67\tdef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n    68\t                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n    69\t                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n    70\t    \"\"\"Data Bites and Reports together, most recently updated first,\n    71\t    optionally narrowed to one type and/or one status.\"\"\"\n    72\t    items = [(ctype, item) for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES if content_type in (\"\", ctype.key)\n    73\t             for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)]\n    74\t    items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[1][\"updated_at\"], reverse=True)\n    75\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    76\t        request, \"admin/content.html\",\n    77\t        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n    78\t         \"items\": items, \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES,\n    79\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n    80\t         \"chosen\": {\"type\": content_type, \"status\": status}},\n    81\t    )\n    82\t\n    83\t\n    84\t@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    85\tdef preview(body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    86\t    \"\"\"The sanitized HTML for a Markdown body, for the edit forms' live\n    87\t    preview. Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n    88\t    return HTMLResponse(render_markdown(body))\n=== app/templating.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n     5\tfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n     6\t\n     7\tfrom app import settings\n     8\tfrom app.auth import csrf_token\n     9\tfrom app.flash import confirmation\n    10\tfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n    11\tfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n    12\t\n    13\t\n    14\t\n    15\t@pass_context\n    16\tdef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    17\t    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    18\t    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    19\t    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n    20\t    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    21\t    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n    22\t\n    23\t\n    24\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n    25\ttemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\n    26\ttemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\n    27\ttemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\n    28\ttemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\n    29\ttemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n=== app/auth.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\n     4\titsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\n     5\tre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\n     6\taccount ends its sessions at once.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\timport secrets\n    11\timport sqlite3\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import users\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    19\t    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n    20\t\n    21\t\n    22\tdef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    23\t    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    24\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    25\t    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    26\t    if user is None:\n    27\t        request.session.clear()\n    28\t        raise LoginRequired\n    29\t    return user\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tdef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    33\t    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    34\t    if not users.is_director(user):\n    35\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    36\t    return user\n    37\t\n    38\t\n    39\tdef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    40\t    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    41\t    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    42\t    request.session.clear()\n    43\t    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    44\t    csrf_token(request)\n    45\t\n    46\t\n    47\tdef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    48\t    request.session.clear()\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    52\t    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    53\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    54\t    if token is None:\n    55\t        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    56\t    return token\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    60\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    61\t    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    62\t    form = await request.form()\n    63\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    64\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    65\t    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n    66\t            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n    67\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n=== app/reports.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     8\t\n     9\tA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\n    10\treplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\n    11\tstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n    12\t`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n    13\t\n    14\tA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\n    15\tfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\n    16\tremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\n    17\tits file and its images.\n    18\t\n    19\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n    20\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n    21\t\"\"\"\n    22\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    23\t\n    24\timport sqlite3\n    25\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    26\t\n    27\tfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\n    28\tfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\n    29\tfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\n    30\tfrom app.users import is_director\n    31\t\n    32\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n    33\t_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\n    34\tLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n    35\t\n    36\tget = _TABLE.get\n    37\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    38\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n    39\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    40\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    44\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    45\t\n    46\t\n    47\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    48\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n    49\t    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    50\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n    51\t\n    52\t\n    53\tdef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    54\t    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    55\t    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n    56\t\n    57\t\n    58\tdef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    59\t    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    60\t    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    61\t    if pdf is None:\n    62\t        return None\n    63\t\n    64\t    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n    65\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n    66\t        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n    67\t\n    68\t    return attach\n    69\t\n    70\t\n    71\tdef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    72\t    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    73\t    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    74\t    if get(report_id) is None:\n    75\t        return False\n    76\t    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n    77\t\n    78\t\n    79\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n    80\t           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    81\t    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    82\t    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    83\t    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    84\t    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n    85\t\n    86\t    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n    87\t        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    88\t        if attach:\n    89\t            attach(conn, report_id)\n    90\t\n    91\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n    92\t\n    93\t\n    94\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    95\t           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    96\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    97\t    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    98\t    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    99\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n   100\t                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n   101\t        return True\n   102\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   103\t\n   104\t\n   105\tdef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n   106\t    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n   107\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n   108\t        removed = conn.execute(\n   109\t            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   110\t            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n   111\t            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n   112\t        ).rowcount == 1\n   113\t    if not removed:\n   114\t        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   115\t    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n   116\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n   117\t    return True\n   118\t\n   119\t\n   120\tdef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n   121\t    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n   122\t    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n   123\t\n   124\t\n   125\tdef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n   126\t    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n   127\t    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n   128\t    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n   129\t    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n   130\t                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n   131\t        return True\n   132\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   133\t\n   134\t\n   135\tdef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n   136\t    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n   137\t    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n   138\t    if name not in images(report_id):\n   139\t        return False\n   140\t    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n   141\t                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n   142\t        return True\n   143\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   144\t\n   145\t\n   146\tdef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n   147\t    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n   148\t    Report.\"\"\"\n   149\t    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n   150\t        return False\n   151\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n   152\t    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n   153\t    return True\n   154\t\n   155\t\n   156\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   157\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n   158\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n=== app/data_bites.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\n     4\tand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\n     5\ta Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\n     6\tauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n     7\t\n     8\tPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n     9\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n    10\t\"\"\"\n    11\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    12\t\n    13\timport sqlite3\n    14\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import chart_images\n    17\tfrom app.content import ContentTable\n    18\t\n    19\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n    20\t_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n    21\t\n    22\tget = _TABLE.get\n    23\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    24\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n    25\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    26\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n    27\t\n    28\t\n    29\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    30\t    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    31\t    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    32\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n    33\t                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tdef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    37\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    38\t    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n    39\t\n    40\t\n    41\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    42\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    43\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n    44\t\n    45\t\n    46\tdef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    47\t    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    48\t    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n    49\t        return False\n    50\t    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    51\t    return True\n    52\t\n    53\t\n    54\tdef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    55\t    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    56\t    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tdef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    60\t    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    61\t    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    62\t    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n    63\t        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n    64\t\n    65\t\n    66\tdef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    67\t    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    68\t    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n    69\t        return False\n    70\t    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n=== app/main.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\n     4\tat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\n     5\there. Keep this file small.\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\timport sys\n    10\tfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\n    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n    14\tfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\n    15\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom app import db, settings\n    18\tfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\n    19\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, public, reports, users\n    20\t\n    21\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\n    22\tALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n    23\t\n    24\t\n    25\t@asynccontextmanager\n    26\tasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    27\t    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    28\t    db.init_db()\n    29\t    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n    30\t        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n    31\t              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n    32\t              file=sys.stderr)\n    33\t    yield\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    37\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    38\t    app.add_middleware(\n    39\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n    40\t        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    41\t    )\n    42\t\n    43\t    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, admin.refused_page)\n    44\t\n    45\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    46\t    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n    47\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    48\t\n    49\t    app.include_router(public.router)\n    50\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    51\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    52\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n    53\t    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    54\t    app.include_router(reports.router)\n    55\t\n    56\t    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    57\t    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    58\t    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    59\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n    60\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    61\t    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n    62\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n    63\t\n    64\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n    65\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    66\t    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n    67\t        if rest == \"\":\n    68\t            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n    69\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    70\t\n    71\t    return app\n    72\t\n    73\t\n    74\tapp = create_app()\n","numLines":781,"startLine":30,"totalLines":810}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7a53f1e2-5bbf-4394-8752-3b6ee5e2b10d","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"77a9bbb5-4476-4402-bbd7-5d7dd9e381fa","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> {"parentUuid":"df195df1-9690-4559-bb0a-d495f8227514","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fad55ecc-8406-451a-8f08-d2791da5b5dd","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VZeQGD8kjLXZPszekBFin7","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T11: Chart images on Reports (issue #13).\n\nThe checks on an upload itself (formats, size, count, names) are T10's shared\ncode, tested there; here, what a Report adds: the lockdown, the Report's\npages and export, and independence from its attached PDF.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import reports, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import PDF, pdf, post_with_file, reports_file\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import crawl, published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import (CHART, WEBP, img_attributes, img_tags, png, png_bytes,\n                                         preview_div)\n\nPNG = png()[1]\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, rid: str, file, *, with_csrf=True):\n    return post_with_file(c, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images\", {}, file, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef delete_image(c: TestClient, rid: str, name: str, *, with_csrf=True):\n    return post_form(c, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/{name}/delete\", {}, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef stored(rid: str) -> list[str]:\n    folder = settings.UPLOADS / \"images\" / \"reports\" / rid\n    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir()) if folder.exists() else []\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, rid: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef edit_report(c: TestClient, rid: str, file=None, **override):\n    return post_with_file(c, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", {**REPORT, **override}, file)\n\n\n# Who may add or delete a Report's images\n\ndef test_analyst_uploads_to_a_draft_report_and_the_edit_page_lists_it(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create_report(analyst)\n\n    response = upload(analyst, rid, png())\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\"\n    assert \"![Description](image:fall-by-class.png)\" in analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert stored(rid) == [\"fall-by-class.png\"]\n\n...\n    assert upload(director, rid, png(\"director.png\")).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_a_locked_report_shows_its_images_but_no_image_forms(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create_report(analyst, body=CHART)\n    upload(analyst, rid, png())\n    publish(director, rid)\n\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert img_tags(preview_div(page)) == [\n        f'<img src=\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/fall-by-class.png\" alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">']\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images' not in page\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images' in director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n\n\ndef test_upload_checks_are_t10s(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create_report(analyst)\n    for file, message in [((\"chart.svg\", b\"<svg/>\", \"image/svg+xml\"), \"Only PNG, JPEG, or WebP\"),\n                          (png(content=b\"<html></html>\"), \"not a valid PNG\"),\n                          ((\"\", b\"\", \"application/octet-stream\"), \"Choose an image\")]:\n        response = upload(analyst, rid, file)\n        assert response.status_code == 400 and message in response.text, file\n    for i in range(10):\n        upload(analyst, rid, png(f\"chart-{i}.png\"))\n    response = upload(analyst, rid, png(\"chart-10.png\"))\n    assert response.status_code == 400 and \"This Report already has 10 images\" in response.text\n    assert len(stored(rid)) == 10\n\n\ndef test_image_routes_404_for_a_missing_report_or_image(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    rid = create_report(director)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n    assert upload(director, \"9999\", png()).status_code == 404\n    assert delete_image(director, \"9999\", \"fall-by-class.png\").status_code == 404\n    assert director.get(\"/admin/reports/9999/images/fall-by-class.png\").status_code == 404\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/reports/9999/preview\", {\"body\": CHART}).status_code == 404\n    for name in (\"..%2F..%2Fcms.db\", \"FALL-BY-CLASS.png\", \"no-such.png\"):\n        assert director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/{name}\").status_code == 404, name\n        assert delete_image(director, rid, name).status_code == 404, name\n    assert stored(rid) == [\"fall-by-class.png\"]\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_report_deletes_its_images_and_its_file(client_as):\n...\n    assert edit_report(analyst, rid, (\"chart.png\", PNG, \"image/png\")).status_code == 400\n    assert stored(rid) == [] and not reports_file(rid).exists()\n\n\n# Login and CSRF\n\ndef test_every_report_image_route_requires_login(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    rid = create_report(director)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n\n    for method, path in [(\"get\", f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/fall-by-class.png\"),\n                         (\"post\", f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images\"),\n                         (\"post\", f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/fall-by-class.png/delete\"),\n                         (\"post\", f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/preview\")]:\n        response = getattr(client, method)(path, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\", path\n    assert stored(rid) == [\"fall-by-class.png\"]\n\n\ndef test_report_image_forms_carry_csrf_and_a_stripped_post_is_rejected(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    rid = create_report(director)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    for action in (f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images\", f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/fall-by-class.png/delete\"):\n        form = re.search(rf'<form[^>]*action=\"{re.escape(action)}\".*?</form>', page, re.S)\n        assert form and 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in form.group(0), action\n\n    assert upload(director, rid, png(\"other.png\"), with_csrf=False).status_code == 403\n    assert delete_image(director, rid, \"fall-by-class.png\", with_csrf=False).status_code == 403\n    assert stored(rid) == [\"fall-by-class.png\"]\n\n\n# The image: reference, as for a Data Bite\n\ndef test_the_preview_shows_the_image_from_the_admin_console(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create_report(analyst, body=CHART)\n    upload(analyst, rid, png())\n\n    expected = f'<img src=\"/admin/reports/{rid}/images/fall-by-class.png\" alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">'\n    preview = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/preview\", {\"body\": CHART})\n    assert preview.status_code == 200 and img_tags(preview.text) == [expected]\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert img_tags(preview_div(page)) == [expected]\n    assert f'\"/admin/reports/{rid}/preview\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_the_public_page_and_the_export_show_the_image_relatively(client_as, client, tmp_path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    rid = published_report(director, body=CHART)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n\n    expected = '<img src=\"../images/reports/factbook/fall-by-class.png\" alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">'\n    assert img_tags(content_body(client.get(\"/reports/factbook.html\").text)) == [expected]\n    served = client.get(\"/images/reports/factbook/fall-by-class.png\")\n    assert served.status_code == 200 and served.content == PNG\n    assert served.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"image/png\"\n    assert served.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert img_tags(site[\"reports/factbook.html\"].decode()) == [expected]\n    assert site[\"images/reports/factbook/fall-by-class.png\"] == PNG\n\n\ndef test_an_unknown_name_renders_nothing(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    body = \"Before ![Missing chart](image:no-such.png) after\"\n    rid = published_report(director, body=body)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n\n    for html in (post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/preview\", {\"body\": body}).text,\n                 preview_div(director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text),\n                 content_body(client.get(\"/reports/factbook.html\").text)):\n        assert \"<img\" not in html and \"Missing chart\" not in html, html\n        assert \"Before\" in html and \"after\" in html\n\n\ndef test_script_in_the_description_is_inert(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    body = '![x\" onerror=\"alert(1)](image:fall-by-class.png) ![<script>alert(1)</script>](image:fall-by-class.png)'\n    rid = published_report(director, body=body)\n    upload(director, rid, png())\n\n    for html in (content_body(client.get(\"/reports/factbook.html\").text),\n                 post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/preview\", {\"body\": body}).text):\n        assert [set(attributes) for attributes in img_attributes(html)] == [{\"src\", \"alt\"}] * 2\n        assert \"<script\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_the_edit_page_warns_of_an_empty_description_without_blocking_the_save(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create_report(analyst)\n    upload(analyst, rid, test_a_new_data_bite_never_inherits_images_left_under_its_id(client_as, client):\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\ntests/test_success_messages.py:175:    # = client.get(path)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, f\"broken link to {path}\"\n        seen[path] = response.content\n        if not path.endswith(\".html\"):\n            continue\n        for link in re.findall(r'(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', response.text):\n            assert not link.startswith(\"/\") and \"://\" not in link, (path, link)\n            queue.append(normpath(join(dirname(path), link)))\n    return seen\n\n\n# What a_site_with_drafts puts in its drafts, and nowhere else.\nDRAFT_LEAKS = (b\"Unreleased enrollment\", \"\"\"Setup: a published Data Bite and a published Report with its file,\n    beside a draft Data Bite and a draft Report with its own file.\"\"\"\n    published_bite(analyst)\n    create_bite(analyst, slug=\"unreleased-bite\", title=\"Unreleased enrollment count\")\n    rid = published_report(director)\n    assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    assert post_with_file(analyst, \"/admin/reports\",\n                          {**REPORT, \"slug\": \"draft-cds\", \"title\": \"Draft CDS\"},\n                          pdf(\"unreleased-cds.pdf\", PDF + b\"% DRAFT-MARKER\\n%%EOF\\n\")\n                          ).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_no_draft_is_reachable_anywhere_on_the_public_site(client_as, client):\n    a_site_with_drafts(client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\"))\n\n    site = crawl(client)\n    assert {\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"/reports/factbook.html\",\n post_form(client_as(\"editor\"), path, {**item, \"slug\": \"index\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"index is reserved\" in response.text\n\n\ndef published_bite(director, body=payload)\n    published_report(director, body=payload)\n\n    for path in (\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"/reports/factbook.html\"):\n        html = It is served under the item's admin\npath (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/preview/), which is the preview's own copy of\nthe site: its links stay relative, as the export's, and a <base> places the\npage at its path in that copy.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import PDF, pdf, post_with_file\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import PAYLOAD, assert_inert\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import (DRAFT_LEAKS, a_site_with_drafts, crawl, nav,\n                                        published_bite, published_report)\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, img_tags, png\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import upload as upload_to_bite\nfrom tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\n\nBANNER = \"Draft preview, not published\"\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, published_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, published_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef preview(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str | None = None, *, with_csrf=True, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form (or, with no item, the create form) to its Site preview.\"\"\"\n    path = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview\" if item_id else f\"/admin/{kind}/preview\"\n    return post_form(c, path, form, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef framed(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview an admin page embeds, as the frame shows it.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\"[^>]*srcdoc=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)\n    assert match, \"no Site preview frame on the page\"\n    return html.unescape(match.group(1))\n\n\ndef base_of(page: str) -> str:\n    [base] = re.findall(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\">', page)\n    return base\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every href and src on the page but its <base>'s.\"\"\"\n    return [link for tag, link in re.findall(r'<(\\w+)[^>]*?(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', page)\n            if tag != \"base\"]\n\n\ndef without_preview_marks(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The page without its banner and <base>: what the export would write.\"\"\"\n    page = re.sub(r'\\s*<base href=\"[^\"]*\">', \"\", page)\n    return re.sub(r'\\s*<p class=\"site-preview-banner\"[^>]*>[^<]*</p>', \"\", page)\n\n\ndef stored_row(kind: str, item_id: str):\n    return (data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports).get(int(item_id))\n\n\n# The public page, as if published\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, publish\", KINDS)\ndef title</h1>\" in page\n    assert content_body(page) == \"<p>Unsaved <em>body</em></p>\\n\"\n    assert base_of(page) == f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview/{kind}/{item['slug']}.html\"\n    # The admin not published\" banner. It is served under the item's admin\npath (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/preview/), which is the preview's own copy of\nthe site: its links stay relative, as the export's, and a <base> places the\npage at its path in that copy.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\n\nBANNER = \"Draft preview, not published\"\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, published_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, published_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef preview(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str | None = None, *, with_csrf=True, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form (or, with no item, the create form) to its Site preview.\"\"\"\n    path = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview\" if item_id else f\"/admin/{kind}/preview\"\n    return post_form(c, path, form, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef framed(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview an admin page embeds, as the frame shows it.\"\"\"\n html.unescape(match.group(1))\n\n\ndef base_of(page: str) -> str:\n    [base] = re.findall(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\">', page)\n    return base\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every href and src on the page but its <base>'s.\"\"\"\n    return [link for tag, link in re.findall(r'<(\\w+)[^>]*?(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', page)\n            if tag != \"base\"]\n\n\ndef test_a_drafts_site_preview_is_its_public_page_with_the_unsaved_edits(\n        client_as, kind, item, create, publish):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n\n    response = preview(analyst, kind, item_id, title=\"Unsaved title\",\n                       slug=item[\"slug\"], body=\"Unsaved *body*\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    page = response.text\n    assert f'<p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">{BANNER}</p>' in page\n    assert '<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"../style.css\">' in page\n    assert \"<h1>Unsaved title</h1>\" in page\n    assert content_body(page) == \"<p>Unsaved <em>body</em></p>\\n\"\n    assert base_of(page) == f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview/{kind}/{item['slug']}.html\"\n    # The admin console's own furniture stays out of it.\n    assert \"csrf_token\" not in page and \"/admin\" not in without_preview_marks(page)\n\n\ndef test_a_data_bites_preview_has_its_date_line(client_as):\n It is served under the item's admin\npath (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/preview/), which is the preview's own copy of\nthe site: its links stay relative, as the export's, and a <base> places the\npage at its path in that copy.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import PDF, pdf, post_with_file\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import PAYLOAD, assert_inert\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import (DRAFT_LEAKS, a_site_with_drafts, crawl, nav,\n                                        published_bite, published_report)\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import CHART, img_tags, png\nfrom tests.test_t10_chart_images import upload as upload_to_bite\nfrom tests.test_t11_report_chart_images import upload as upload_to_report\n\nBANNER = \"Draft preview, not published\"\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, published_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, published_report, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef preview(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str | None = None, *, with_csrf=True, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form (or, with no item, the create form) to its Site preview.\"\"\"\n    path = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/preview\" if item_id else f\"/admin/{kind}/preview\"\n    return post_form(c, path, form, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef framed(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview an admin page embeds, as the frame shows it.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\"[^>]*srcdoc=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)\n    assert match, \"no Site preview frame on the page\"\n    return html.unescape(match.group(1))\n\n\ndef base_of(page: str) -> str:\n    [base] = re.findall(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\">', page)\n    return base\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every href and src on the page but its <base>'s.\"\"\"\n    return [link for tag, link in re.findall(r'<(\\w+)[^>]*?(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', page)\n            if tag != \"base\"]\n\n\ndef without_preview_marks(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The page without its banner and <base>: what the export would write.\"\"\"\n    page = re.sub(r'\\s*<base href=\"[^\"]*\">', \"\", page)\n    return re.sub(r'\\s*<p class=\"site-preview-banner\"[^>]*>[^<]*</p>', \"\", page)\n\n\ndef stored_row(kind: str, item_id: str):\n    return (data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports).get(int(item_id))\n\n\n# The public page, as if published\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, publish\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_drafts_site_preview_is_its_public_page_with_the_unsaved_edits(\n        client_as, kind, item, create, publish):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    item_id = create(analyst)\n\n    response = preview(analyst, kind, item_id, title=\"Unsaved title\",\n                       slug=item[\"slug\"], body=\"Unsaved *body*\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    page = `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    return _data_bite_page(_as_if_published(form, saved))\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    page = _report_page(report)\n    return Page(page.path, page.template, page.context, page.images, nav_reports=nav)\n''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF","description":"Add Site preview rendering to public_site"}},"wireIngestContext":{"toolu_01FbP6AUVfnSyMzACwR3Y34r":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"d9557b42-d0a1-488c-8344-623b57253d36","apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011CfaCFKFXbVHyW8Vf9G3Qf","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"1ef0da44-1b62-4a32-b30a-9ffbd93c8d63","timestamp":"2026-09-30T19:44:12.712Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"77a9bbb5-4476-4402-bbd7-5d7dd9e381fa","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main","slug":"twinkling-moseying-papert"}

Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\"]) data.append(name, form.elements[name].value);\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\np='templates/admin/report_edit.html'\ns=open(p).read()\nold='''  <div {"parentUuid":"a8087b69-0d13-4a6e-aecc-835be26c6155","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fad55ecc-8406-451a-8f08-d2791da5b5dd","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/skills/synced/c27537d6-7985-4b77-ad11-069d3a056783_3f882942-dfce-46fb-9f0d-f268a67a0f23/chrome-browser\n\n# Claude in Chrome\n\nClaude in Chrome is a browser extension. Its tools, named `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`, act in the person's real Chrome, in new tabs alongside the person's own, with their existing sign-ins. Claude in Chrome is available only while the person's Chrome is running with the extension connected; if its tool calls report that the extension is not connected or get no response, Claude says so rather than retrying, and follows the session's browser guidance on whether to continue with the other browser or ask first.\n\nIf the only Claude in Chrome tool present is `enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome`, Claude calls it first: it turns Claude in Chrome on for this conversation, and the `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*` tools appear once it has run.\n\n## Loading the tools\n\nIf the `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*` tools are deferred (meaning they have to be loaded through ToolSearch before use), Claude loads every tool it expects to need in ONE ToolSearch call, because the select query accepts a comma-separated list and each extra ToolSearch call costs a full round trip. The core set to start with:\n\n```\nToolSearch with query \"select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp\"\n```\n\nClaude adds task-specific tools to that same call when the task obviously needs them: `read_console_messages` and `read_network_requests` for debugging, `form_input` for forms, `gif_creator` for recordings, `javascript_tool` for page scripting. A second ToolSearch is only for a tool the task turned out to need later.\n\n## Starting a session: tab context first, then a new tab\n\nAt the start of each browser session Claude calls `mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp` first, to see the person's current tabs and understand what they may want to work with. Then:\n\n1. Claude reuses an existing tab only when the person explicitly asks to work with it.\n2. Otherwise Claude opens a new tab with `mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp` and works there, and, unless the person wants them kept, closes the tabs it created before finishing.\n3. Claude never reuses tab IDs remembered from an earlier or different session. If a tool reports that a tab does not exist or is invalid, or the person closes a tab, or a navigation error occurs, Claude calls `tabs_context_mcp` again for fresh tab IDs.\n\n## Site permissions\n\nClaude in Chrome acts on a site only once the person has allowed it; depending on their settings the person may be prompted per site, in the extension or in the app. When a tool call is waiting on or refused that permission, Claude tells the person and waits for them to allow it rather than working around it. A site the person declines is their decision; Claude moves on.\n\n## Recording a GIF\n\nFor multi-step interactions the person may want to review or share, Claude can record them with `mcp__claude-in-chrome__gif_creator`. Claude captures a few extra frames before and after each action so playback is smooth, and gives the file a meaningful name (for example \"login_process.gif\").\n\n## Reading console output\n\n`mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages` reads the page's console. Console output can be verbose, so when Claude is looking for specific entries it passes the `pattern` parameter (a regular expression), for example pattern \"[MyApp]\" to keep only the application's own logs.\n\n## Alerts and dialogs\n\nClaude does not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or other browser modal dialogs through its actions. Those dialogs block all further browser events, so the extension stops receiving commands. Instead:\n\n1. Claude avoids clicking elements likely to raise a confirmation dialog (for example a \"Delete\" button) unless necessary.\n2. If it must interact with such an element, Claude warns the person first that this may interrupt the session.\n3. Claude can use `mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool` to check for and dismiss an existing dialog before proceeding, and prefers `console.log` plus `read_console_messages` over `alert` for debugging.\n\nIf a dialog does get triggered and the browser stops responding, Claude tells the person they need to dismiss it manually in Chrome.\n\n## Staying on task, and when to stop\n\nClaude stays focused on the specific task and does not wander into unrelated pages. Claude stops and asks the person how to proceed, explaining what it tried and what went wrong, when any of these happen:\n\n- browser tool calls fail or return errors after 2 or 3 attempts\n- the extension gives no response\n- page elements do not respond to clicks or input, or pages do not load or time out\n- the task turns out to involve unexpected complexity or tangents\n- several approaches have not completed the task\n\nClaude does not keep retrying the same failing action.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"74fdf49c-54f7-4d63-a1c3-1f61c11a8432","timestamp":"2026-09-30T19:49:34.868Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_015PfxB8wJcywLFCh3uJQviV","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"77a9bbb5-4476-4402-bbd7-5d7dd9e381fa","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main","slug":"twinkling-moseying-papert"}
